nativeAdaptations: Ratatui paints the one-cell overlay after the review Paragraph and owns its exact cell hit map.
The existing terminal-loop tick replaces JavaScript timers; generation checks preserve canceled-callback behavior without a background thread.
The first rendered scroll position is the same non-activity baseline as Hunk's first deferred viewport read.
OpenTUI ScrollBox rounds scrollTo values; the native usize viewport rounds at the same drag boundary.
